topic: From Roots to Fractals: The Magic of Newton's Method

sections.title: Prerequisites: Tangent Lines as Approximators
lecture_lines: Derivatives represent the slope of a curve.
Tangent lines approximate a curve's local behavior.
We use them to find root approximations.
animations: Show a function curve f(x) in #FFFFFF.
Draw tangent line to f(x) at a in #00FFFF.
Label the root of the tangent line as x_1 in #FFFF00, displayed alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Newton's Method: The Iterative Search
lecture_lines: Newton's method uses an iterative formula.
Tangent lines project toward the root.
Each step improves the current approximation.
animations: Show function f(x) and initial guess x_0 in #FFFFFF.
Draw tangent line at (x_0, f(x_0)) in #00FFFF.
Display the formula x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n) in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Mystery of Basin Boundaries
lecture_lines: Extend Newton's method to complex numbers.
Three roots create three distinct basins.
Points converge to different root destinations.
animations: Display three roots of a cubic polynomial in #FF0000. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg]
Show complex plane color-coded by root attraction in #00FFFF.
Highlight chaotic boundaries between colored regions in #FFFF00. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/terrain.svg]

sections.title: Generating Newton Fractals
lecture_lines: Color roots based on final convergence.
Chaos emerges from simple iteration rules.
animations: Color a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pixel.svg] based on convergence to roots.
Assign unique colors to each root basin in #00FF00, #0000FF, #FF0000.
Visualize the fractal geometry emerging as depth increases.

sections.title: Summary & Reflection
lecture_lines: Simple rules yield complex global results.
Linear math creates beautiful, infinite fractals.
Iterative methods reveal hidden mathematical depths.
